thread:
anya: quick note from canary: hot-prefix handoff caused short-lived read regression (~2m) when prefill on target lagged and source tombstones were compacted. looks like overlapping eligibility windows.

tom: logs?

anya: small trace:
anya: ```
W demote: prefix=pfx_900 action=soft-evict reason=grace_expire
I prefetch: miss prefix=pfx_900 route=cold
W tombstone: compact small scan prefix=pfx_900
```

kelly: so compaction raced with prefill. we need to avoid freeing structure until target confirms warm.

raj: proposals: 1) add short handoff token+prefill_ack, 2) delay tombstone compaction when recent handoff seen, 3) adaptive grace extension based on hot_score.

tom: prefer minimal ops-first: tombstone delay (30s) + feature-flagged 20s grace bump during migration. cheap and fast.

kelly: agree. longer term we should design idempotent handoff token (target signals ready) and a cooperative read-through fallback if prefill fails. include metrics: handoff_attempts, prefill_success.

ops-bot: deploy queued: ops/anya/handoff-tombstone-delay -> canary-fleet (rolling 2).

anya: I'll add smoke test steps and push a Grafana panel. will follow up with RFC for handoff token design.
